On delivered server LivingUpdate, outer tickCount%10 condition and inner tickCount%40 plus float<0.5 gate invert current side-owned BooleanData. Only successful sample saves mode and requests tracking packet. A failed sample preserves either active or inactive phase; hits never spend shield or alter sampling. Delivered server LivingAttack iterates all target affixes. Shielding exact OUT_OF_WORLD reference exception returns true before sound; other attacks when stored mode true submit no-damage sound then return false, causing caller setCanceled(true).
